facts.statement: Logging in during the weekend of April 11-14 earns Cardie items, with each item available on only one listed day, so the player must log in to the TCG every day.
facts.quote: Log in the weekend of April 11th through April 14th and you can earn these cool Cardie items.

article_summaries.title: Outfit Your Cardie in Style This Weekend!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing a weekend login reward promotion for the Trading Card Game (TCG) running April 11-14, 2013. Each Cardie item is tied to one specific day, and a tournament win gives a bonus item; all rewards are once per account. The post date is inferred from the page's relative timestamp ('3 days ago' at a 2013-04-13 capture), so it is approximate.
